Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Egon Zehnder site by conflating an industry category (Private Capital/Private Equity) with the firm’s service field, and ignored the instruction to extract the exact wording of services. Instead of identifying Egon Zehnder’s core services (executive search and board/leadership advisory), the Planner concluded the firm offers Private Equity services, leading to the wrong final answer.
